newsitem.title: USA: Telco lifts credit line to $100 million.
newsitem.headline: Telco lifts credit line to $100 million.

text.p: Telco Communications Group Inc said on Friday it raised its bank credit facility to $100 million, replacing the existing $65 million line of credit.

Telco will use the new, unsecured three-year facility to finance working capital growth and capital expenditures, support acquistions and fund other general corporate purposes, the company said in a release.
NationsBank will serve as the lead bank in the new credit syndicate. Other banks in the syndicate include Riggs Bank and Mellon Bank.
Telco said it expects that new credit facility will substantially reduce the cost of borrowed funds.
Telco, of Chantilly, Va., is a nationwide switch-based provider of a full spectrum of long distance telecommunications products and services targeting residential, commercial and carrier customers.
